# Malawi

Everything this library holds for Malawi, with provenance. Tilt = OLS slope of ln(rate) on wealth rank 0–1; ogcore consumes tilt ÷ 100 (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).

## Adult-mortality route for calibration

This country has its **own census measurement — use it** (rows above), not the general gradient.

## Provenance notes

- Two censuses (1998, 2008) make Malawi the worked example that the gradient steepens as income rises: the measured 45q15 tilt moved from −0.02 to −0.28 as income per head roughly doubled, within 0.07 of what the general gradient's income rule predicts.
